newsitem.title: USA: Saliva Diagnostic says director steps down.
newsitem.headline: Saliva Diagnostic says director steps down.

text.p: Saliva Diagnostic Systems Inc said Dr. Joel Scheinbaum resigned as a director after the company failed to allow him to review and copy certain records.

The company said it has agreed to make the records available to Dr. Scheinbaum for inspection prior to its board of directors meeting and at the meeting, but was concerned that the documents remain confidential.
Saliva Diagnostic makes a variety of saliva and serum-based tests to detect HIV and other diseases.
No details were provided in the company's statement and company officials were not available for comment.
Scheinbaum couldn't be reached for comment.
